title: 基石资产管理（香港）梁：AI芯片利润率超60%不可持续，未来3-6个月需
speaker: Michael Liang

segments.en: I think the second quarter results kind of come out late July that's one of the real test.
segments.zh: 我认为二季度业绩在7月底出炉，那才是真正的考验。

segments.en: But if you look at the Samsung results, I mean the great results but look at the net margins.
segments.zh: 但看看三星的业绩，虽然很好，但看净利率。

segments.en: I mean high nigs and micron are like you know they grow net margins over 60 percent.
segments.zh: 像英伟达和美光，净利率超过60%。

segments.en: If you look at LV or even Apple their net margins around 20, this is three times of a consumer name.
segments.zh: 而LV甚至苹果的净利率只有20%左右，这是消费类公司的三倍。

segments.en: It's just not normal that will create a lot of imbalances within the AI ecosystem.
segments.zh: 这很不正常，会在AI生态中造成大量失衡。

segments.en: AI probably is the way with the future but we need to look at how much it cost when you run the AI business.
segments.zh: AI或许是未来方向，但我们需要看运行AI业务的成本。

segments.en: When you have increasing impact from hyperscalers most of the incremental expenditure going to the cost rather than the compute capacity, that alarm bell to me.
segments.zh: 当超大规模企业的影响增加，大部分增量支出流向成本而非算力，这对我来说是警钟。

segments.en: So 60 percent north of 60 percent net margin it's just not sustainable and healthy.
segments.zh: 所以60%以上的净利率是不可持续也不健康的。

segments.en: I mean we saw Apple raising prices of some of their products already right.
segments.zh: 我们看到苹果已经提高了部分产品价格。

segments.en: So you're basically saying demand destruction will happen pretty soon.
segments.zh: 所以你是在说需求破坏很快就会发生。

segments.en: It's already happening but it's going to be very visible in the next three to six months.
segments.zh: 已经发生了，但在未来3到6个月会非常明显。
